annotations.title: Search statutes, the Journal officiel and collective agreements

description:
Keyword search in French codes and statutes (LEGI), the Journal officiel
(JORF) or collective agreements (KALI). Known article: `get_law_article`.
Keywords in French.

Example: search_legislation(query="harcèlement moral", code="CT")
Agreement (corpus="kali"): idcc="1486" without query → table of contents;
query="Syntec" → agreements, texts; KALI id → sections or text.

Args:
    query: keywords (all required; "in double quotes": exact form), or a KALI id;
        optional for kali with idcc; OR/AND/NOT/NEAR in UPPERCASE between two words
        are operators (NEAR = within 10 words); lowercase words are plain words
    corpus: legi | jorf | kali | europe
    code: legi: code abbreviation or name ("CT", "code du travail", "CEDH")
    nature: jorf: LOI, DECRET, ARRETE…
    idcc: kali: IDCC number
    date_min: YYYY-MM-DD (legi, jorf)
    date_max: YYYY-MM-DD (legi, jorf)
    limit: results per page (max 50)
    offset: pagination offset
    tout: kali: include repealed texts
